description: Transcritical R744 (CO2) heat pump with gas cooler. COP curve = f(T_evap, T_water_out, P_high) using a Carnot-fraction approach with explicit gas-cooler-outlet temperature pinch and an optimum high-side pressure correction.

unit.name: Generic 50 kW_th transcritical CO2 heat pump for high-temperature water heating
unit.source: Lorentzen, G. (1994). Int. J. Refrigeration 17, 292-301; Sarkar, J., Bhattacharyya, S., Ram Gopal, M. (2004). Int. J. Refrigeration 27, 830-838.

carnot_fraction_base.note: Effective fraction of Carnot at optimum high-side pressure

P_high_opt_a.note: Liao et al. (2000) optimum P_high slope on T_gc_out

P_high_opt_c.note: Intercept; tuned so P_opt sits in transcritical regime (>= ~74 bar)

T_gc_out_pinch.note: Pinch between CO2 gas-cooler outlet and water inlet
